purpose: Re-record the host facts P16 rests on with the exact command retained, so the counts are reproducible rather than asserted: what provider credential a container could use, and what this host carries that a cell must not reach.
argv:
echo "== provider credentials reachable for a container session =="
echo "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set: $([ -n "${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY-}" ] && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN set: $([ -n "${ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN-}" ] && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "ANTHROPIC_PROFILE set: $([ -n "${ANTHROPIC_PROFILE-}" ] && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "ant CLI: $(command -v ant || echo absent)"
echo "~/.config/anthropic: $([ -d "$HOME/.config/anthropic" ] && echo present || echo absent)"
echo "auth env files under ~/.config/bounded-discovery: $(find "$HOME/.config/bounded-discovery" -maxdepth 3 -name "*.env" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " ")"
echo
echo "== host absence: what is on this machine that a cell must not reach =="
echo "linked worktrees of the repository under test: $(git -C /Users/jack/Development/skills worktree list | wc -l | tr -d " ")"
echo "revealed cleartext truth entries in the working tree: $(ls /Users/jack/Development/skills/docs/research/bounded-discovery-decision-2026-09-11/revealed | wc -l | tr -d " ")"
echo "evaluator-only directories: $(ls -d "$HOME"/.config/bounded-discovery/issue-* 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " ")"
command_line:
sh -c '
echo "== provider credentials reachable for a container session =="
echo "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set: $([ -n "${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY-}" ] && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN set: $([ -n "${ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN-}" ] && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "ANTHROPIC_PROFILE set: $([ -n "${ANTHROPIC_PROFILE-}" ] && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "ant CLI: $(command -v ant || echo absent)"
echo "~/.config/anthropic: $([ -d "$HOME/.config/anthropic" ] && echo present || echo absent)"
echo "auth env files under ~/.config/bounded-discovery: $(find "$HOME/.config/bounded-discovery" -maxdepth 3 -name "*.env" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " ")"
echo
echo "== host absence: what is on this machine that a cell must not reach =="
echo "linked worktrees of the repository under test: $(git -C /Users/jack/Development/skills worktree list | wc -l | tr -d " ")"
echo "revealed cleartext truth entries in the working tree: $(ls /Users/jack/Development/skills/docs/research/bounded-discovery-decision-2026-09-11/revealed | wc -l | tr -d " ")"
echo "evaluator-only directories: $(ls -d "$HOME"/.config/bounded-discovery/issue-* 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " ")"
'
